name: Aztec Smash

features.name: Escalating bonus multiplier
features.description: Grows from 10x up to 1,000x in free spins.

review:
A 7x7 jungle tumble game with the Smash Multiplier: after every spin or tumble, random spots can get marked, and any win touching a marked spot is multiplied by 10x.

Three to seven scatters give 10 to 30 free spins, where the Smash Multiplier starts at 10x and grows – by 10x up to 100x, then by 100x up to 1,000x. Up to 9,000x and a 96.52% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
